description: This file contains unit tests for the HttpPushClientActor class, testing connection establishment, disconnection, error handling, and message publishing over HTTP/HTTPS using Akka HTTP in a Java environment.

classes.name: HttpPushClientActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HttpPushClientActor, covering connection handling, error scenarios, and message publishing over HTTP/HTTPS.

methods.name: createActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and server binding before tests.

methods.name: stopActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a Connection object, with optional TLS based on the isSecure parameter.

methods.name: createClientActor
methods.description: Creates Props for the HttpPushClientActor with given proxy and connection.

methods.name: getActorSystem
methods.description: Returns the ActorSystem instance used in tests.

methods.name: connectAndDisconnect
methods.description: Tests establishing and closing the connection.

methods.name: testTCPConnection
methods.description: Tests successful TCP connection to the server.

methods.name: testTLSConnectionFails
methods.description: Tests failure when establishing HTTPS connection with invalid certificates.

methods.name: testTLSConnection
methods.description: Tests successful TLS/HTTPS connection with proper certificates.

methods.name: publishTwinEvent
methods.description: Verifies publishing of a twin event via HTTP POST including header mapping and payload correctness.

methods.name: placeholderReplacement
methods.description: Tests correct URL placeholder replacement in target addresses.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts an adaptable object to its JSON string representation.
